shell_commands: cd src/transport/ws && timeout 30 npx vitest run validation.test.ts 2>&1 | head -100
timeout 120 npm run typecheck 2>&1 && echo "✓ Typecheck passed"
npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/index.ts 2>&1
git add src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/index.ts && git status

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(transport): create wire-protocol cursor type to resolve typecheck errors

ListSessionsMessage was using SessionCursor from the store layer, which allows Date values. The wire protocol should only carry string/number types. Create SessionCursorWire for the protocol layer with only string|number updatedAt, and update messageHandler to use the narrower type.

- Add SessionCursorWire interface excluding Date
- Update ListSessionsMessage.before to use SessionCursorWire
- Update handleListSessions signature for type safety
- Add test verifying validated cursor type compatibility
- Export SessionCursorWire from public API

Fixes typecheck error: ListSessionsMessage not assignable to handler parameter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main 2>&1 && echo "✓ Merge completed"
git push origin HEAD && git status
timeout 60 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites|Tests:"
